meta.title: Add Bid is offered on an Upcoming event
gaps: Verify offering and acceptance on an Upcoming event: the prepared event is live, and its state and schedule cannot be changed.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify offering and acceptance on an Upcoming event: the prepared event is live, and its state and schedule cannot be changed.

steps.note: Open the prepared event's Participants tab.
Assert surrogate bidding is offered and enabled for the invited vendor.
Record a bid on the vendor's behalf from the buyer console.
Assert the surrogate bid was accepted rather than merely opening the bid drawer.
